subject.title: feat: add Computer Use plugin manifest contract

question: Should OpenClaw accept `contracts.computerUseProviders` and `computerUseProviderMetadata` as a public metadata-only plugin manifest contract for macOS Computer Use discovery with these field names and permission semantics?
rationale: The patch is additive, but it freezes plugin-author API surface and the metadata is meant to inform host decisions around Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions.

options.title: Confirm and land one canonical branch
options.body: Regenerate docs, confirm host code treats the metadata as discovery-only, then merge either this PR after rebase or the rebased sibling PR as the single canonical implementation.

options.title: Revise the contract shape first
options.body: Rename or narrow the fields, platform shape, permission enum, or MCP metadata before publishing a plugin contract.

options.title: Pause for host design alignment
options.body: Keep the branch draft or close the duplicate path until the macOS host binding model is settled enough to publish the manifest surface.

recommendation.title: Confirm and land one canonical branch
recommendation.body: Regenerate docs, confirm host code treats the metadata as discovery-only, then merge either this PR after rebase or the rebased sibling PR as the single canonical implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history-backed ownership signal for the manifest/docs surface and also opened the rebased sibling branch used by the Computer Use stack.
